newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Jan-Apl metal futures/options trade surges.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Jan-Apl metal futures/options trade surges.

text.p: South Korea's base metals futures and options trades surged to 485,558 lots in the first four months of this year from 43,293 lots in the same year ago period, according to data from the Korea Futures Association.
Of the total, aluminium trades were 280,457 lots and copper trades 201,713 lots. Each lot of both metals is equivalent to 25 tonnes.
All of South Korea's futures transactions are conducted on overseas exchanges, as South Korea has no futures exchange of its own.
In the whole of 1996, South Korea's base metals futures and options trades totalled 503,553 lots.
